_note: C-15. Per-category demand seasonality, SOURCED. An entry exists only where a source or an owner statement supports it; a category with no entry is OMITTED (UNKNOWN), never guessed. months are 1-12 and are national/Sun-Belt generalizations: Arkansas weather is not separately sourced (UNKNOWN). Every claim below was taken from a web-search result summary on 2026-10-07; the pages were NOT independently read in full (see `verification`). Entries marked basis RECOMMENDATION rest on an owner statement and need Michael's confirmation.
demand_rule: strong if month in peak_months; weak if month in low_months; otherwise normal

entries.note: Strong spring demand; dealers clear riding mowers in early fall (first week of October) and rarely discount May-September, so October resale is weaker. Dealer new-mower pricing is used as evidence for used-mower demand by inference.

entries.note: Event-driven: demand spikes after outages (tropical-storm remnants in late summer/fall, winter ice storms), so timing is partly unpredictable. Spring is the quiet period.

entries.note: Utility-trailer demand is low in winter, builds from March, peaks May-August (moves, landscaping, construction). Sun Belt markets show a shallower curve than northern ones.
